claims.statement: Eligible novices can start with low-demand, effort-governed movement practice and run/walk participation while observations establish a personal baseline.
conditions: The 20-minute entry, optional 3×30-second jog and 1×5 unloaded practice are familiarization choices. Walking is a valid entry/exit; walking experience alone does not prove running or loaded-hinge competence.
Use only demonstrated/understood unloaded movement patterns; RIR≥3 is an approximate effort cue, not measured reserve or universal minimum. Check technique/effort and do not invent external loads.
Specify complete tasks and actual available windows; disclose that initial practice is not a proven optimal strength/hypertrophy dose or complete performance program.
claims.uncertainty: Structural evidence and broad healthy-adult training principles support a reversible entry, not an individualized efficacy or injury-risk estimate.

claims.statement: Personally familiar effort-governed run work can be composed with low-demand preparation and a contextually earned, bounded one-dimensional progression.
conditions: Supplied current comparable work/effort exposure governs main work. No watch VO2 estimate, old/downhill result or easy pace may create a high-intensity or race target.

Ten-minute easy preparation and five-minute easy cooldown are coaching selections; allow shorter/terminated exit on response and fit all components to availability. They are not fabricated prior history.

Progress only to a supplied previously tolerated next dose with compatible current comparable response and future-week fit; preserve intensity while changing one dimension. No universal percentage threshold.
Familiar strides mean relaxed nonmaximal efforts with prior compatible exposure and eligible current easy preparation; no maximal sprint, novel hills or uncalibrated VO2 equivalence.
claims.uncertainty: No exact 3×5, stride, 55→60-minute or warmup optimum is established; the reviewed bound uses personal comparable exposure and reversible execution.

claims.statement: Comparable repeated performance and effort can justify a small same-task progression or regression while preserving movement purpose and recovery.
conditions: Use the same movement/configuration and complete effort/rest context; require actual equipment increments. Repetitions/load change one dimension and cannot be inferred from unrelated exercise kilograms.
A lower familiar load or rep choice is preferred only when the comparator shows it resolves a material mismatch; do not claim a universally optimal one-repetition or two-kilogram adjustment.
No single noisy performance observation becomes a hard rule. Effort/RIR remains uncertain, and observation consistency/comparability matters more than an arbitrary universal count.
claims.uncertainty: No validated algorithm guarantees the best individual adaptation; bounded decisions must remain corrigible through future response.

claims.statement: Reducing unperformed optional local demand can be a proportionate response when essential work remains compatible and a goal-critical stimulus deserves protection.
conditions: Current local evidence and essential-versus-optional role must be explicit; muscle overlap alone is insufficient.
Only optional unperformed work may be omitted under this envelope. If core work is affected, assess a different admissible option or ask; do not label essential removal equivalent.
Explain the accepted accessory-opportunity cost and review subsequent function/key-session response; no quantified causal interference claim.
claims.uncertainty: The exact omitted accessory is coaching judgment under a bounded role; chronic effect of one omission is not measured.

claims.statement: Converging recovery concerns plus actual inability to sustain intended hard work can justify ending the remaining hard suffix and reassessing the future stimulus.
conditions: Require both relevant converging current context and material impaired work; one uncorroborated wearable or isolated bad signal does not trigger this rule.
Preserve the completed prefix; remove only remaining hard work. Do not add a speculative partial hard repetition to appear productive.
Five-minute easy exit is optional and conditional on comfortable current easy effort; stopping is allowed immediately. No diagnosis of overtraining, illness or a hidden readiness score.
claims.uncertainty: The exact suffix-stop policy is a bounded reversible coaching inference; the literature does not establish a universal fatigue threshold or guarantee future recovery.

claims.statement: Feasible same-dose rearrangements can prioritize the athlete’s primary/key stimulus while accounting for modality trade-offs and disruption.
conditions: Validate every actual local-time window, duration, overlap and equipment constraint; same dose alone does not establish placement feasibility.
Compare available whole-horizon alternatives, preserving both essential intents when feasible; Run-first/Strength-first orders otherwise admissible compromises and never creates necessity alone.
Do not infer chronic interference from muscle overlap or acute fatigue, nor impose a universal three-hour/twenty-four-hour spacing rule. No stacking/merging missed work by default.
claims.uncertainty: Optimal individual session spacing is not established; endpoint/population findings vary and a scheduling preference is not a physiological guarantee.

claims.statement: Repeated comparable same-athlete observations may softly rank already admissible same-dose options while retaining measurement noise and causal uncertainty.
conditions: Require purpose permission, same-athlete provenance, nonduplicated valid observations, recency/comparability and current schedule feasibility.
Conflicting/context-changed data weaken the preference. A software recurrence requirement is not a scientifically validated universal confidence count.
Rank only existing independently admissible options; do not create doses, contraindications, immutable response traits or causal physiology from associations.
claims.uncertainty: Associative ranking is an uncertainty-aware policy, not demonstrated causal personalization efficacy or a validated physiological learner.

claims.statement: Known nonclinical interruption with current ordinary function and eligible context can use an easy effort-governed re-establishment entry rather than requiring a prior postpause test for entry itself.
conditions: Interruption reason/exposure and current eligibility must be known. Pain, illness, functional limitation or clearance-dependent return routes clinically; an unexplained pause requires clarification.

Fifteen-minute run entry is an upper proposed duration with walk/stop option; it is not forced continuous running or restored former capacity. Current ordinary walking is relevant context, not proof of hard-run tolerance.
Strength uses an explicitly familiar low-demand configuration, one initial set and approximate RIR≥4 cue; no unknown load and no automatic prior-week restoration.
Later tasks/progression are conditional on observed execution/effort/function/recovery. Do not score an unconditional complete former week as established.

A complete compatible current postpause demonstration may outrank the generic entry prior, only with current comparable effort/function and complete configuration; this is observed current capacity, not restored historical capacity or elapsed-time inference.
claims.uncertainty: Direct nonclinical pause-length dose evidence is sparse. Approval covers reversible low-demand re-establishment, not a universal detraining curve or rehabilitation.

claims.statement: A separately familiar complete alternative may preserve movement purpose while accounting for skill, equipment, effort and schedule rather than pretending loads transfer arithmetically.
conditions: Alternative has its own complete configuration, familiar competence and load basis. Equipment mass or movement name alone does not establish equivalence.
Preserve the goal/essential role, fit current window and remaining work; avoid simultaneous progression.
When competence/configuration is genuinely unknown, ask essential establishment questions or use a separately approved low-demand entry.
claims.uncertainty: No universal exercise-equivalence or kilogram conversion is supported; a substituted movement may accept a specificity trade-off.

retainedGaps.reason: No reviewed complete goal-specific baseline-relative joint race-week selector; endurance taper principles do not uniquely determine concurrent strength adjustments.
No validated crosswalk from watch estimate/easy pace/old noncomparable race to current high-intensity dose.

counterevidence: S09 contradicts a ten-percent injury-prevention guarantee.
S05 prevents noisy observed change from becoming causal individual-response certainty.
S01 cautions exact RIR target precision and rigid older recipe conformity.
